summary: One step in an activity log: what happened, in the user's language, with a status carried by shape and text.
useWhen: a child of AgentActivity — it is not usable elsewhere

useInstead.when: it is a row in a dropdown

active.use: happening now. Only one step should carry it

failed.use: did not finish. Say why in `detail`

skipped.use: deliberately not run — a branch not taken, a cached result

detail.note: the result, a count, a tool name — whatever makes the step checkable

guarantees: the status name is rendered as visually hidden text, so it is never carried by the glyph's colour alone
each status has a differently shaped glyph, which survives greyscale and forced-colours mode

antiPatterns.why: a failure the reader cannot diagnose is just a red mark
it renders an <li>, which is only valid inside a list
